title: Define the bounded native execution contract
goal: Define an implementable contract for one bounded agent execution that preserves native identities, settings, resources, workspace constraints, and uncertain outcomes.
scope: Specify only the trusted ports and behavior needed by one admitted execution scenario.
Define native provider discovery without copying credentials or inventing unsupported metadata.
Define admission, invocation, cancellation, termination, and uncertainty as distinct recorded facts.
acceptance: A reviewed contract assigns the final admission check for current eligibility, resources, settings, and enforceable workspace access to the kernel.
The contract defines scripted provider checks for success, denial, failure, cancellation, and uncertain termination without real user-data mutation.
The required execution record distinguishes requested, sent, and observed settings and retains typed provider failures.
The contract requires implementations to state which resource and workspace guarantees are enforced and which remain unknown.
context: This task is intentionally unscheduled until durable session state is implemented and accepted.
